original_submission.content:
import json
from pathlib import Path
import runpy

ROOT = Path("storage/shared/atlas/analysis/inquirer_veritas_power_law_sim")
script = ROOT / "analysis_v4.6_near_band.py"
# Ensure __main__ so the script's main() runs and writes the file
runpy.run_path(str(script), run_name="__main__")

out_path = ROOT / "sweep_results/v4.6.6/NEAR_BAND_REPORT_v4.6.6.json"
rep = json.loads(out_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
preview = {
    "report_path": str(out_path),
    "counts": rep.get("counts"),
    "first": rep.get("top10_outside", [None])[0]
}
print(json.dumps(preview, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
